title: Replace seed_manager_test.dart's 7 silent early-return guards with an explicit precondition instead of a vacuous pass

evidence.quote:
if (oldVersion <= 0) {
        // Unlikely, but skip gracefully if bundledSeedVersion == 1.

why: bundledSeedVersion is 15 today (lib/core/database/seed_version.dart:13), so `if (oldVersion <= 0) return;` never fires and every guarded test body runs its real assertions — but the guard is copy-pasted 7 times (lines 176, 200, 212, 223, 236, 694, 758) as unconditional insurance against bundledSeedVersion ever dropping to 1. If that ever happens, up to 7 tests covering version-mismatch rollback, replacing-content-db logging, upgrade/extract-failed logging, rolled-back logging, and boundary behavior silently report PASS having executed zero assertions, with no `skip:` marker in test output to reveal it.
recommendation: Replace the 7 repeated guards with a single documented precondition (e.g. a top-of-file `assert(bundledSeedVersion > 1, 'these tests assume bundledSeedVersion > 1')` or restructure the version arithmetic) so a future bundledSeedVersion of 1 fails loudly instead of vacuously passing.
acceptance_criteria: No test in seed_manager_test.dart can complete with zero assertions executed when bundledSeedVersion <= 1; either the file fails fast via assert, or the affected tests use `skip:` with a stated reason so it's visible in test output.
